test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

BASE : EASB :: MINE : EINM :: CALM : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1. BASE: EASB 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0fd96f99e2646992cb1a79a9c4790503cdb444ede58052a165dc1dac56eac44.png] 

2. MINE: EINM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f86fa319fda213504c80e137b4920ed8a4248398897c948ebc1a1239225af58e.png] 

Similarly, in CALM: ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e7d5e479f4ef9b874bfdf12b2b93d595e3cff14018f6ba1c0e232a5c75b1a22.png] 

Hence, **'MALC'** is the correct answer.
